subject: PayTrail: split invoice onboarding and VAT responsibility
messages:
From: Elena Markovic <elena@paytrail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@paytrail.com
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Split billing setup across PayTrail entities - initial details

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this — PayTrail is onboarding Redwood and we need to make sure invoicing can be split between two legal entities and routed to separate cost centers each month. Summary of requirements: 

- Monthly invoice should include line-level allocation by team code (ENG / OPS / SALES).
- Two legal entities: PayTrail NL (VAT ID NL12345) and PayTrail EU (VAT ID DE98765). We expect a pro-rata split of seats and a handful of service line items that are entity-specific.
- VAT handling: some customers will want reverse-charge on service fees for NL; others require VAT charged. We need your guidance on how Redwood can present VAT lines per entity.
- Our procurement needs an example invoice that shows: line allocations, VAT breakdown per entity, and PO mapping.

We attached our vendor onboarding form; happy to hop on a 30-min call if it helps. What info do you need from our side to get this set up?

Thanks,
Elena Markovic
Head of Finance Operations
PayTrail Inc.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 95 KB)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Markovic <elena@paytrail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Split billing setup across PayTrail entities - initial details

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the vendor form. We can support line-level allocations and per-entity VAT lines, but there are a few operational details to confirm so we build the correct invoice generation template. Quick next steps from our side: 

1) Please confirm the PO number format you will send and whether each PO will reference an entity (NL vs EU) or a single umbrella PO for both.
2) Send a mapping of your internal team codes to the desired cost centers (if you can include the CSV we can ingest it directly).
3) Confirm whether reverse-charge will be applied by you or whether you need us to show VAT and a note saying "reverse charge applies" (some accounting teams prefer explicit zero-VAT reverse-charge lines).

I've attached a Redwood split-invoice template and a short VAT allocation guidance doc that explains the options we can surface on the invoice. If that looks right, I propose a 30-minute handoff call with Ben (billing ops) and Marissa (collections) this week to lock the SOW and start a pilot month.

Available times (PST): Wed 10:00–11:00, Thu 08:30–09:00, Thu 16:00–17:00. Let me know which works.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_split_invoice_template.xlsx (Excel, 42 KB); vat-allocation-guidance.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Split billing setup across PayTrail entities - question for billing/collections (internal)

Ben / Marissa — forwarding PayTrail's request. TL;DR: they need monthly invoices split by line into two legal entities, with VAT broken out per entity and optional reverse-charge notation for NL. Items:

- Can our billing engine attach a cost center code per invoice line and emit separate subtotal + VAT lines per entity (i.e., invoice shows Entity A subtotal, VAT for Entity A; Entity B subtotal, VAT for Entity B; total)?
- If the customer sends one umbrella PO, can we still map lines to two legal entities for accounting (we may need to emit two linked invoices or a single multi-entity invoice with explicit entity sections). What's our current capability?
- If we can't, propose fallback options we can offer to the customer.

If we can do it, we should also confirm whether Collections will accept receiving payments to two different bank accounts (one per entity) or whether they want PayTrail to remit to a single account and we internally split.

I've attached PayTrail's onboarding form they returned. I will set up the handoff call after we confirm internal constraints.

— Priya

Priya / Marissa — quick note after checking billing platform capabilities and consulting with finance:

1) Our invoicing system can generate a single PDF that contains multiple "entity sections" (we call them split sections) with per-section subtotal, VAT amount, and entity VAT ID printed. That matches PayTrail's ask and keeps a single document on their side.
2) If they provide one umbrella PO, we can reference the PO at the top-level and then annotate each line with the internal cost center code and an "Entity" column. Our downstream accounting will post per-entity entries based on that metadata.
3) Payments: Finance prefers payments to be remitted to the entity-specific bank account when possible. If PayTrail can't do that, Collections can accept a single payment and we will initiate an internal settlement to move amounts to the appropriate ledger. That adds an internal clearing step (recommended to avoid complexity for smaller customers).

Action items:
- Priya: propose call time to PayTrail and request the mapping CSV (team code -> cost center).
- Marissa: once PayTrail confirms PO approach, please prepare the collections note for dual-account setups and confirm whether we need a special bank remittance instruction template.

I'll prepare a sample invoice PDF and a CSV mapping of how lines will be emitted from our billing pipeline; attaching that to this thread.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
